## TemplateManager.\_DEFER property

Internal miss sentinel for template getters.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static readonly _DEFER: unique symbol;
```

## Remarks

Contract: missing template/base/lang falls back `base → default` then `lang → default`<!-- -->. On total miss the getter throws `DEFER` internally and returns \`\` (message/description) or `[]` (keyboard) — empty-string and empty-array results from compiled templates are preserved, never treated as a miss.
